semiconductor_relevance: High — Taiyo Nippon Sanso provides specialized gases and systems for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Taiyo Nippon Sanso offers advanced gas supply systems and exhaust gas treatment solutions tailored for semiconductor processes. Their products include the Intelligent Gas Supplying System (IGSS) and Blisters Burner H2, which effectively manage gas supply and treat harmful emissions in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Intelligent Gas Supplying System (IGSS) for gas management
Blisters Burner H2 for exhaust gas treatment
CO2 capture systems for emission reduction
